summary:
Reviewed snapshot 1b6e3cb584df8746f4c22738874d811a785b48f5 and the d43b2b6 diff. All 146 embedded packet files match the working copy byte-for-byte. R16-B01 is resolved. Two newly identified core S0 admission defects remain, so both verdicts are revise. Both offending rules already exist at d43b2b6 (required gate_payload.epsilon_share and pairwise specificity/overlap rejection); neither is a regression introduced by the expansion fix.

Method 1 — independent hand reproductions: inc8(255) executes const/add/retval in three rows: B=3 -> (0,0,3), B=2 -> (0,1,2). sum_db(0) takes 3 caller rows + 6 callee rows + final retval = 10: B=10 -> (0,0,10), B=9 -> (0,1,9). With n=1, the second 16-cell call record exceeds stack=31 at row 16: code 3, payload 0, steps 16. With n=17, the first recursive body addresses db[16], and the explicit boundscheck faults at row 13: code 7, payload 0. CLI agrees in all six cases. Independently assembled the literal 261-byte inc8 semantic envelope; SHA-256 is 8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93. Reconstructed zero’s data envelope, sum’s @$0 self-reference SCC envelope/member hash and sum_db’s structural layout envelope; all four published hashes match. Independently reconstructed the exact R16 omission bytes and all four pins, including §9.2 section/boundary-LF exclusion.

Method 2 — reversal: traced a complete assignment inverse in machine.rs: recover old pc with the two exchanges, cancel its successor using the retained frame, exchange the destination back, recompute the old-state assigned value to clear the slot, and clear flag/succ/frame. Traced the mixed call inverse C5 through C1 and return inverse R5 through R1: counters precede restored-address reads; argument capture clears only after callee locations return; delivery uses restored callee fp. Recursive single-step tests and the 256-input every-prefix sweep pass. CLI reverse sum_db(1), B=24/stack=32/depth=2, gives equals_entry=true, frames_clean=true, counters [0,2,0,0,0], pc=pc_prime=0. Traced §7.4 nested/f/g call-ret segments through undo_frame/undo_record: inner uncall removes clock.read’s memory/device/tape delta; outer uncall skips those reversed frames and marker. CLI nested completes in 11 instructions with result 0, clock=0 and empty tape; whole reversal restores the complete snapshot and memory digest d200538a3f99cb418e35b18dffcc60039675a6b257e089a679cce7290b4af44c.

Method 3 — readings: revisited SPEC-QUESTIONS 1–32 against the packet spec, including row indices, HALT idling, counter widths, SCC order, literals and metadata integer spelling, call tiers, borrow proof/return obligations, claim tuples, composition, dynamic SSA, qif lifetime reversal, measurement order, dotted-path limitations and address namespaces. No additional unjustified recorded reading was established. The two newly found schedule restrictions have no such entry; §§17 item 9 and 11 supply the determining behavior. The disclosed target/schedule/interval stages remain unverified rather than silently proved.

Method 4 — marker audit: scanned the whole embedded crate for todo!, unimplemented!, unwrap/expect/panic/unreachable, unsupported/not-supported and assumption/approximation markers; saved 1414 packet hits in the review worktree .tmp/r17-packet-audit-hits.txt. Production has no todo!/unimplemented! stubs. Production hits group into validated shapes/lexical forms, checked collection/graph/history invariants, explicit device diagnostics, and approximate display paths alongside exact decisions. Inspected borrow-history guards, epoch-rank construction, schema-reference lookup and machine/history guards; test/support hits are assertion and fixture-construction machinery, while historical response/docs hits describe prior work. No new panic or silent-fallback witness was established.

Method 5 — inventory cross-check: compared §4 row/opcode families with object/schema/validation dispatch and oracle/machine/classical/action execution, §5.4 fault handling, §§3.6–3.7 slot forms, §7.4 history frame kinds, the 163 metadata productions and their semantic checks, CLI dispatch/README and suite obligations. Cross-checking §17 defaults against the schema exposed mandatory epsilon_share; tracing §11 matching against validate_schedule_details exposed the nonmaximal-tie rejection. Generated TABLE tests cannot establish that TABLE itself admits every spec-defined default. The broader reread focused on admission, dispatch, identity and inverse paths; this review and passing tests do not prove every ISA behavior.

All five ignored sweeps separately pass, 107.10 seconds summed runner time: u8 division/remainder 0.53s, 17-wire borrow 2.74s, checked borrow certificate 15.76s, 200000-program discipline differential 84.36s (70931 admitted, all clean; 129069 rejected), recursive prefixes 3.71s.
